name: Mine Gatehouse v1 — Exterior vs Tutorial Island mining reference
subtitle: Pyramid-roofed gate tower over the road passage, gabled winch house with louvred dormer, half-octagonal ore bay, gate lantern
review_note: The gatehouse reads as a fourth distinct composition: the tallest roof on the island so far, a road that genuinely passes through twin doors under a portcullis, and a lower working house with a dormer over the head-frame. Fieldstone base, timber bays, shuttered windows, fitted doors and the lantern finial keep the family. Held below 9.0: the pyramid courses are still flat slabs, the gate leaves lack iron studs, and the winch house gable end is plain plaster without a hoist beam or loading door.
improve: Add a hoist beam and hay-door to the winch house gable, stud the gate leaves, and stagger the pyramid courses into stepped shingles.
